description: Every Promo campaign in this account, with its window, whether it is ahead, running or over, and how many posts are to look at, scheduled, posted or did not go out. A release's campaign is kind release; between releases a campaign is a month (kind between_releases), and none starts by itself: start_campaign with between_releases plans the next one. Also lists upcoming releases that have no campaign yet, and campaigns being planned right now.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.
